key_line.detail: $3.09-3.17 per share, midpoint 3.13, ~+0.8% vs 2026 guide midpoint (3.08-3.13); assumes ~$50m acquisitions and $25-50m development (down from $50-100m in 2026). No 2027 consensus sourced; management's stated long-term target is 2-3% annual Core FFO growth (Nasdaq call highlights). FAA Chicago lease extended through July 2027, firm through April 2027. Release time of day not stated in the exhibit read (released_at_utc null).

guidance.detail: 2026 Core FFO raised at the low end to $3.08-3.13 (from $3.07-3.13); 2027 newly issued $3.09-3.17, soft growth versus the company's own 2-3% target; no 2027 street number found to compare against.

call.detail: Call at 11:00 ET, during the session; the 2027 bridge (what happens to FAA Chicago after July 2027, refinancing costs) will be discussed then. A risk an exit at the open avoids and an exit at the close takes; for a short the call is more likely to reinforce a soft guide than rescue it, but management may frame the extension positively.
